summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 reported bug fixes on Electroyes preview site. All 3 bugs are FIXED and verified on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Root redirect (/ -> /preview-site/) works; hero logo renders (naturalWidth=439, naturalHeight=500, displayed at 320x320); Tienda link is a normal <a> inside header <nav> with the same visual style as other menu items, no floating overlay/ey-tienda-btn exists; ARSolutions credit is visible in footer with correct href/target/rel; nav buttons (Inicio, Servicios, Contacto) smooth-scroll to their sections.

issues: Minor structural note (non-blocking): the main menu items (Inicio/Servicios/Instalaciones de Aire/Zonas/Contacto) are rendered as <button> elements inside a div, while 'Tienda' and 'WhatsApp' are <a> tags inside a separate <nav> element. Visually they look correct and inline in the top bar; the Tienda link uses the same tailwind classes as the other items (text-gray-700 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors font-medium). Semantically they could be placed inside the same <nav>, but this is not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Header markup mixes semantics: main menu items are <button> (for smooth-scroll to hash sections) while the Tienda cross-page link is <a>. Consider consolidating everything inside a single <nav> for better semantics/a11y.
Not blocking, but hero logo is displayed at 320x320 CSS while natural size is 439x500 — no visible quality loss.
